name: Java Language Server
description: Installiert den Eclipse JDT Language Server (Snapshot) nach ~/.local/share und bindet ihn für Java ein. Benötigt JDK 17.

lspServers.label: Eclipse JDT Language Server
command: D="$1/.local/share/jdt-language-server"; J="$PREFIX/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk/bin/java"; L=$(ls "$D"/plugins/org.eclipse.equinox.launcher_*.jar 2>/dev/null | head -n1); [ -n "$L" ] || { echo "JDT LS nicht installiert" >&2; exit 1; }; mkdir -p "$1/.cache/jdtls-workspace"; exec "$J" -Declipse.application=org.eclipse.jdt.ls.core.id1 -Dosgi.bundles.defaultStartLevel=4 -Declipse.product=org.eclipse.jdt.ls.core.product -Xmx1G --add-modules=ALL-SYSTEM --add-opens java.base/java.util=ALL-UNNAMED --add-opens java.base/java.lang=ALL-UNNAMED -jar "$L" -configuration "$D/config_linux" -data "$1/.cache/jdtls-workspace"
